problem.constraint: vertical deflection under 8 mm, 200 mW average output, 10-million-step fatigue life

mechanism.mechanism: The gap width between the cover plate and the stopper controls the mechanical actuation amplitude, thereby limiting the strain applied to the piezoelectric element during impact-driven loading.
mechanism.intervention: Add an adjustable stopper to the floor tile that sets a 4 mm maximum vertical deflection gap between the cover plate and the piezoelectric element, so that footfall impacts are mechanically limited to a safe strain range instead of transmitting full 800 N force directly to the element.
mechanism.expected_effect: Reduced peak mechanical stress on the piezoelectric element, decreasing fatigue crack initiation and propagation, thereby extending fatigue life toward the 10-million-step requirement while maintaining 200 mW average output.
mechanism.mechanism_source_span: "At a 4 mm gap width between the cover plate and the stopper (the mechanical actuation components of both energy harvesters) and a cover plate pressing frequency of 2 Hz, PEH generated 27.64 mW, 1."
